clips.title: SK海力士美国上市认购七倍，谁在抢筹？

subtitles.en: Neil, I'm confused. I thought foreigners have been selling the career market aggressively recently and now apparently they want to buy the SK high-nix listing, the ADR, and it's seven times over subscribed.
subtitles.zh: Neil，我有点困惑。我以为外资近期在大举抛售韩国市场，但现在他们似乎又想买SK海力士的ADR，而且超额认购七倍。

subtitles.en: Yeah, there's obviously one of the most volatile parts of the market.
subtitles.zh: 是的，这显然是市场波动最大的领域之一。

subtitles.en: Globally has been career dominated by the two tech giants, Samsung and the high-nix.
subtitles.zh: 全球来看，韩国市场一直由三星和SK海力士这两大科技巨头主导。

subtitles.en: Part of the effects of that volatility is around these levied ETFs in Asia around the memory trades.
subtitles.zh: 这种波动部分源于亚洲围绕存储芯片交易的杠杆ETF。

subtitles.en: So perhaps the appetite for the US listing is seeing perhaps as a means of getting away from some of the volatility
subtitles.zh: 因此，对美国上市的兴趣或许被视为规避部分波动的一种方式，
en_highlights: getting away from some of the volatility

subtitles.en: even though the listing will be linked obviously to the underlying stock.
subtitles.zh: 尽管该上市显然会与标的权益资产挂钩。

subtitles.en: So there are mixed messages for sure. There is appetite clearly fully offering.
subtitles.zh: 所以信号确实混杂。这次发行显然有需求。

subtitles.en: Has that come from retail? Is it institutions difficult to know?
subtitles.zh: 是来自散户还是机构？很难判断。

subtitles.en: It is easier for foreign investors, especially US investors, to own stock listed in the US and it is to necessarily invest directly in South Korean stocks because you would need a local ID
subtitles.zh: 对外国市场参与者（尤其是美国市场参与者）来说，持有美国市场比直接**韩国权益资产更容易，因为后者需要本地身份或使用国际券商等。

subtitles.en: or otherwise use international brokerages, etc. So it's an easier path for them if that's the exposure that they want.
subtitles.zh: 所以如果他们想要这种敞口，这是更便捷的途径。

subtitles.en: But clearly there is appetite from somewhere within the market for this listing.
subtitles.zh: 但显然市场对此上市仍有需求。
